annotations.title: Check before you connect or pay

description: Check before you connect or pay. Use when developers, businesses and AI agents need public endpoint facts before connecting or paying: x402 terms, signed offers, recipient and price history, MCP tool changes and domain observations. No payment is sent. Costs 5 credits or US$0.05 per call through x402 when enabled. Cost: 5 credits per call.

domain.description: Domain to check at its HTTPS root, including any advertised MCP server.

expect.description: Optional pay_to, max_amount, asset and network strings. max_amount is an integer in the asset's atomic units, compared separately for every offer.

method.description: GET (default) or POST. Empty POST only after the GET shows a payment challenge or the site's OpenAPI declares a paid POST.

url.description: Public paid endpoint or MCP URL. Supply url or domain. Per-call x402 requires url.

name: prepay_check
